[SWS_CM_10526] Mapping of Send method
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_-
Dds_00015
⌈
When instructed to send a trigger message, the DDS Binding shall construct and send
a new sample of the equivalent DDS Topic data type as described in [FO_PRS_DDS_
00202].
⌋
The DDS serialization rules are defined in section 7.2.3.7.
